en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small town in a valley surrounded by forested hills. A prominent Gothic-style church with a tall spire and clock tower stands on the left, with clustered residential and village buildings in the foreground and middle ground. The landscape suggests a rural, hilly region. At the top left, printed text identifies the place as Neuhausen (Bez. Dresden).
